observation.visible_scene: A rocky mountain creek viewed from a fixed position. A large lichen-mottled boulder with a few small green leafy plants occupies the left foreground; a flat speckled rock with a single thin bare twig sticking upward sits at the bottom center. The mid-right of the frame is a churning pool of white, aerated water flowing over submerged stones. In the upper-left background a small waterfall sheets down a smooth pale rock slab, and the right side shows a jumble of tan boulders bordering a calmer, brownish-tinted pool.
visible_changes: The white frothy water in the center-right pool continuously churns, its bubble patterns and eddies reshaping and drifting downstream from frame to frame.
The background waterfall flows steadily, its sheet of white water maintaining a roughly constant form while the surface texture flickers.
Ripples and reflections on the calmer right-hand pool shift subtly over time.
The foreground boulder, plants, flat rock, twig, and the right-side boulders stay locked in the same frame positions, indicating the camera is stationary and the only motion is the flowing water.
The thin twig and the small plants show no visible sway, remaining static throughout.
outside_clip_unknowns: What lies upstream of the waterfall and downstream of this pool.
The cause or rate of the water flow, weather, and any sound.
Whether this turbulent pool connects to the waterfall or to a separate channel.
uncertain_details: Any tiny camera jitter is indistinguishable from the moving water, so camera motion is treated as none.
The exact velocity and direction of individual eddies cannot be measured from these samples.
The water's true color is partly obscured by aeration and reflections.
